sentence: Welcome to the jungle, a huge sea of green alive with the sounds of animals.
translation: 欢迎来到丛林——一片回荡着动物声响的绿色海洋。
analysis: 开篇即入景：Welcome to... 直接把读者请进雨林（说明文的沉浸式开头）| a huge sea of green：同位语复指 the jungle，a sea of 比喻“茫茫一片”（He looked down and saw a sea of faces. 一片人海）；green 形容词名词化 | alive with the sounds of animals：形容词短语作后置定语——be alive with 充满、到处是（活物）（The pond was alive with frogs.）| 一句话三层递进：丛林→绿海→声响，视觉听觉双通道 | 课堂拓展：bring sth alive 使生动、come alive 变得活跃
pattern: Welcome to + N, a sea of + N + alive with + N（同位语+比喻）
imitationCn: 欢迎来到夜市——一条飘满食物香气的灯光长河。
imitationHint: Welcome to the night market, a long river of lights → alive with the smells of food（同位语+比喻+alive with）
imitationAnswer: Welcome to the night market, a long river of lights alive with the smells of food.

sentence: As the largest rainforest in the world, it plays a significant role in maintaining the fine balance of the Earth's ecosystem.
translation: 作为世界上最大的雨林，它在维系地球生态系统的微妙平衡方面发挥着举足轻重的作用。
analysis: As + 名词短语作状语：“作为……”（as 介词用法，非从句）——先给身份再说作用，说明文的定位句式 | play a significant role in + V-ing：在……中发挥重要作用（writing 万能句型；同族 play a part in）| maintain the fine balance 维系微妙的平衡：fine 此处“精细微妙的”（熟词僻义）| the Earth's ecosystem 地球生态系统（eco- 前缀家族：ecology 生态学、eco-friendly 环保的）| 最高级 the largest... in the world 与 significant 呼应——“最大”所以“最重要”，逻辑自洽
pattern: As the + 最高级 + N, S + plays a significant role in + V-ing
imitationCn: 作为班里的老班长，她在维系全班的团结氛围方面发挥着重要作用。
imitationHint: As the long-serving monitor of the class, she plays a significant role in → maintaining the united atmosphere of the whole class
imitationAnswer: As the long-serving monitor of the class, she plays a significant role in maintaining the united atmosphere of the whole class.

sentence: With an area of around 6 million square kilometres, the Amazon rainforest is more than half the size of China.
translation: 亚马孙雨林面积约 600 万平方公里，比中国国土面积的一半还要大。
analysis: With an area of + 数字：with 短语前置交代规模（= Covering an area of...），说明文数据开路的写法 | more than half the size of China：倍数/分数表达的核心结构“倍数 + the size/length/height of + 比较对象”——课堂倍数四式：① 倍数+as+原级+as ② 倍数+比较级+than ③ 倍数+the size of ④ 倍数+what 从句（five times what they earned）| 用“中国的一半”作参照——抽象数字锚定在读者熟悉的事物上，科普写作的黄金技巧 | million 不加 s（前有数词）；millions of 才用复数
pattern: With an area of + 数字, S + is + 倍数/分数 + the size of + N
imitationCn: 这座新图书馆建筑面积约五万平方米，是老馆的三倍大。
imitationHint: With an area of around 50,000 square metres, the new library is → three times the size of the old one（倍数+the size of）
imitationAnswer: With an area of around 50,000 square metres, the new library is three times the size of the old one.

sentence: The Amazon River, from which the rainforest gets its name, is close to 6,400 kilometres in length — roughly 100 kilometres longer than the Yangtze River.
translation: 亚马孙河——雨林因它得名——长约 6400 公里，比长江还长大约 100 公里。
analysis: 课件专项讲解句：from which 为“介词+关系代词”引导的非限定性定语从句（get its name from it → from which... gets its name），介词前置后 which 不可换 that、不可省 | 双逗号把从句包夹在主谓之间——主语与谓语被优雅地隔开，长句骨架依然清晰 | close to 接近（= almost）+ in length 在长度上（two metres in length/width/height 量度表达）| 破折号后补比较：roughly 100 kilometres longer than...——比较级前加具体数字表差值 | 再次用长江作参照，与上句“半个中国”同套路
pattern: S, from which + 从句, is close to + 数字 + in length — 数字 + longer than + N
imitationCn: 这条古街——小镇因它得名——长约两公里，比主商业街还长大约三百米。
imitationHint: The ancient street, from which the town gets its name, is close to two kilometres in length → — roughly 300 metres longer than the main shopping street
imitationAnswer: The ancient street, from which the town gets its name, is close to two kilometres in length — roughly 300 metres longer than the main shopping street.

sentence: Above that is the mass of leaf litter on the dark forest floor.
translation: 在那（根系）之上，是幽暗森林地面上的大片落叶层。
analysis: 课件专项讲解句：介词短语 Above that 置于句首引起完全倒装——正常语序 The mass of leaf litter is above that；倒装让“旧信息（that=上文根系）在前、新信息在后”，上下文衔接如齿轮咬合，这正是说明文分层描写（雨林由下到上逐层介绍）的引擎句式 | 课堂同族：Among these people was his friend Jim. / On top of the hill stands an old temple. | 注意：主语为代词时不倒装（There you are.）| the mass of 大量的（a mass of/masses of + 可数复数或不可数）| leaf litter 落叶层（litter 熟词僻义：枯枝落叶，非“垃圾”）
pattern: 介词短语 + is/stands/lies + 主语（完全倒装）
imitationCn: 在山顶之上，矗立着一座可以俯瞰全城的古塔。
imitationHint: On top of the hill stands an ancient tower → overlooking the whole city（介词短语前置+完全倒装）
imitationAnswer: On top of the hill stands an ancient tower overlooking the whole city.

sentence: Each level of the forest forms its own little world, home to different kinds of living things.
translation: 雨林的每一层都自成一个小世界，是各种生物的家园。
analysis: home to different kinds of living things：名词短语作同位语，复指 its own little world——“逗号 + home to...”是介绍栖息地/所在地的高频亮点表达（The city is home to five universities.）| Each + 单数：each level... forms 谓语单数 | its own little world “自成一体的小世界”——own 强化独立性 | living 课堂四辨析：living 活的（定语/表语）/ alive 活着（表语/后置定语）/ lively 活泼的 / live 现场的、活的（只作定语）| 总括句：为下文逐层介绍各层生物提前立框架
pattern: Each + N + forms its own + N, home to + N（同位语）
imitationCn: 校园的每个角落都自成一道风景，是不同社团的活动天地。
imitationHint: Each corner of the campus forms its own scenery, → home to different clubs' activities（逗号+home to 同位语）
imitationAnswer: Each corner of the campus forms its own scenery, home to different clubs' activities.

sentence: Over the past 50 years, about 17 per cent of the rainforest has disappeared due to human activities such as agriculture and cattle farming.
translation: 在过去的 50 年里，由于农耕和养牛等人类活动，大约 17% 的雨林已经消失。
analysis: Over the past 50 years + 现在完成时 has disappeared：“过去……年来”是完成时的标志性信号词 | 百分数主语 about 17 per cent of the rainforest：谓语随 of 后名词（rainforest 不可数 → 单数 has）——主谓一致复习点（呼应必修一 U4 统计句）| due to 由于（表原因的介词短语；课堂同族替换：because of / owing to / thanks to / on account of；due 还有“预期的、到期的”义：be due to do 预计）| such as 举例引出两个动名词 agriculture and cattle farming | 冷静的数据句：不喊口号，17%+50年自己会说话
pattern: Over the past + 时间, 百分数 + of + N + has + V-ed + due to + N + such as ...
imitationCn: 在过去的十年里，由于电子支付和网络购物等新习惯，这条老街约三成的店铺已经关门。
imitationHint: Over the past decade, about 30 per cent of the shops on the old street have closed → due to new habits such as e-payment and online shopping
imitationAnswer: Over the past decade, about 30 per cent of the shops on the old street have closed due to new habits such as e-payment and online shopping.

sentence: As the impact of human activities continues to grow and the list of species in danger of extinction becomes longer, we are left with a question: can we afford to damage the 'lungs of the planet'?
translation: 随着人类活动的影响持续扩大、濒危物种的名单越来越长，我们面前留下一个问题：我们承受得起破坏“地球之肺”的代价吗？
analysis: 课件句子结构分析句 | as 引导时间状语从句，从句内 and 连接两个并列分句（impact grows / list becomes longer）——双压力并进 | 主句被动 we are left with a question：“被留下一个问题”，人类是被动承受者的语态暗示 | 冒号后直接抛出疑问句：can we afford to do...——afford 与 can 连用表“承受得起（后果）”，非“买得起” | the lungs of the planet “地球之肺”：雨林的经典比喻，引号标记借用 | 全文收束：以问句结尾把答案抛给读者——议论文/说明文“开放式结尾”的范本
pattern: As + 从句 and + 从句, S + are left with a question: can we afford to + V ...?
imitationCn: 随着屏幕时间不断增长、户外活动的清单越来越短，我们面前留下一个问题：我们承受得起告别自然的代价吗？
imitationHint: As screen time continues to grow and the list of outdoor activities becomes shorter, we are left with a question: → can we afford to say goodbye to nature?
imitationAnswer: As screen time continues to grow and the list of outdoor activities becomes shorter, we are left with a question: can we afford to say goodbye to nature?

sentence: Joining us in the studio tonight are James Smith, a local resident; Vincent Brown, senior manager of a local factory; and Julie Archer, chief of the Norgate Environmental Protection Committee.
translation: 今晚来到演播室的嘉宾有：当地居民詹姆斯·史密斯；本地一家工厂的高级经理文森特·布朗；以及诺盖特环保委员会主任朱莉·阿彻。
analysis: 课件专项讲解句：现在分词短语 Joining us... 作表语置于句首引起完全倒装——真正主语是后面三个人名（复数 → are）；与 Reading 的 Above that is...（介词短语前置）合成完全倒装两大形态 | 三个人名各带同位语（身份说明），人名与身份用逗号、三组之间用分号分隔——多重同位语并列时分号防混淆的标点规范 | 三位嘉宾身份暗藏戏剧结构：居民（受害方）/经理（辩护方）/环保官员（仲裁方）——访谈节目的三方对垒开场 | 课堂拓展倒装库：Beyond the river lives an old professor. / Out of every crisis comes the chance to be reborn.
pattern: V-ing短语 + are + 人名, 同位语; 人名, 同位语; and 人名, 同位语（完全倒装+分号并列）
imitationCn: 今天参加座谈的有：高三学生代表王琳；教务处主任李老师；以及三位学生家长代表。
imitationHint: Joining us in the discussion today are Wang Lin, a senior student representative; Mr Li, director of academic affairs; → and three parent representatives（倒装+分号）
imitationAnswer: Joining us in the discussion today are Wang Lin, a senior student representative; Mr Li, director of academic affairs; and three parent representatives.

sentence: The smog in the air has coloured the sky a smoky grey; it's also given me a cough that I can't get rid of.
translation: 空气中的雾霾把天空染成了烟灰色，还让我患上了甩不掉的咳嗽。
analysis: colour + 宾语 + 颜色形容词：“把……染成……色”（colour the sky a smoky grey——宾补是名词化的颜色短语）| 分号连接两个后果分句：天空（环境）与咳嗽（健康），由远及近步步逼人 | a cough that I can't get rid of：that 定语从句，get rid of 摆脱——介词 of 悬空句尾不可丢（呼应必修二 U1 的 attach importance to）| smog 缩合构词法（smoke+fog；课堂同族：brunch=breakfast+lunch、motel=motor+hotel）| 居民视角的控诉句：具体、切身，比抽象说“污染严重”有力得多——议论文举证的示范
pattern: S + has coloured + O + a + adj. + 颜色; it's also given me + N + that I can't get rid of
imitationCn: 连日的暴雨把河水搅成了土黄色，还给沿岸居民带来了挥之不去的担忧。
imitationHint: Days of heavy rain have coloured the river a muddy yellow; → they've also brought riverside residents a worry that they can't get rid of
imitationAnswer: Days of heavy rain have coloured the river a muddy yellow; they've also brought riverside residents a worry that they can't get rid of.

sentence: We've been taking various measures, including the use of new technologies, to reduce pollution in the production process, even though these measures raise our production costs.
translation: 我们一直在采取各种措施——包括使用新技术——来减少生产过程中的污染，尽管这些措施提高了我们的生产成本。
analysis: 课件专项：现在完成进行时 have been taking——动作从过去开始、持续到现在且仍将继续（“一直在采取”），比一般完成时多一层“进行中”的诚意 | including... 介词短语插入举例 | to reduce... 目的状语 | even though 让步从句收尾：“尽管成本上升（仍在做）”——先亮行动再认代价，辩护发言的说服结构（经理在访谈中的自辩）| take measures to do 采取措施（= take steps/action）| in the production process 在生产过程中（process 课堂拓展：in the process of 在……过程中）
pattern: S + have been + V-ing ..., including ..., to + V ..., even though + 从句
imitationCn: 我们一直在尝试各种办法——包括请教学长——来提高复习效率，尽管这些尝试占用了不少课余时间。
imitationHint: We've been trying various methods, including consulting senior students, to improve our revision efficiency, → even though these attempts take up much of our spare time
imitationAnswer: We've been trying various methods, including consulting senior students, to improve our revision efficiency, even though these attempts take up much of our spare time.

sentence: Saving our planet, lifting people out of poverty, advancing economic growth — these are one and the same fight.
translation: 拯救我们的地球、让人们摆脱贫困、推动经济增长——这是同一场战斗。
analysis: 联合国前官员的名言（课文引用）| 三个动名词短语排比作主语群：Saving... lifting... advancing...——环保、扶贫、发展三大议题一字排开 | 破折号后 these 总括回指，谓语 are 复数呼应 | one and the same 同一个（and 强化 same：“完完全全同一场”）——固定强调表达 | fight 单数点睛：三件事不是三场仗，是一场 | 引用权威话语增强论点（quote authority）是议论文的加分手法；lift sb out of poverty 使脱贫（时政高频词块）| 破折号+总括代词的“列举—收拢”结构可整体迁移
pattern: V-ing₁ ..., V-ing₂ ..., V-ing₃ ... — these are one and the same + N
imitationCn: 锻炼身体、调整心态、规律作息——这些是同一场备考。
imitationHint: Building up our health, adjusting our mindset, keeping regular hours — → these are one and the same preparation（三动名词+破折号总括）
imitationAnswer: Building up our health, adjusting our mindset, keeping regular hours — these are one and the same preparation.

sentence: When you think of a fearsome hunter, images of lions and sharks may spring to mind.
translation: 当你想到可怕的猎手时，狮子和鲨鱼的形象可能会立刻跃入脑海。
analysis: When you think of...：第二人称 + 设想句式，科普文与读者对话的开场 | spring to mind 猛然想到、跃入脑海（spring 弹跳的画面感；课堂“突然想到”四件套：It occurred to me that... / It struck me that... / It crossed my mind that... / spring to mind）| images of lions and sharks 作主语——“形象”自己跳出来，物作主语的地道英语思维 | may 委婉推测 | 设悬铺垫：先立读者的刻板印象（狮子鲨鱼），下文再反转（真正可怕的猎手另有其物）——科普文“先破后立”的标准开局
pattern: When you think of + N, images of + N + may spring to mind
imitationCn: 当你想到传统手艺人时，白发老匠人的形象可能会立刻跃入脑海。
imitationHint: When you think of a traditional craftsman, images of grey-haired old masters → may spring to mind（下文可反转：其实很多是年轻人）
imitationAnswer: When you think of a traditional craftsman, images of grey-haired old masters may spring to mind.
